note: Campground on the Sebewaing River (to Saginaw Bay) at 541 Union St, with a boat ramp, rental docks and a fish-cleaning station. The operator's site says 'SEASONAL CAMPING ONLY' for its RV lots; its two cabins ($70 a night, 2-night minimum on weekends) are the only short stays (archived page, June 2026). Treated private (NOT the separate Huron County 'Sebewaing County Park' next door). --Claude
summary: Live website refuses everyone ('Access Denied'; expired self-signed cert; bare domain says 'Malware detected'), so the operator's page was read from the Wayback capture of 2026-06-08 (same text since Nov 2025): 'SEASONAL CAMPING ONLY ... Seasonal Lots Available ... Cabins available for short stays'. Confirmed 20/30/50-amp, water, sewer; season May 1 - Oct 1 plus late season to Dec 1 (closes 12-01); showers. The note's '$70 nightly, 2-night min weekends' is the cabin rate, not RV sites: corrected. Google Maps: open, 4.6 stars / 80 reviews, phone (989) 883-9192 (matches). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here.
flags: Criteria (long-stay tests 2 and 4): the operator's page says 'SEASONAL CAMPING ONLY' for RV lots ('2025 Seasonal Lots Available'; 'Cabins available for short stays'), archived 2026-06-08 and 2025-11-14. No nightly RV rate and no booking engine; the nightly share of RV sites is 0 of ~54-59. The entry's '$70 nightly, 2-night min weekends' is the cabin rate. Drop candidate (seasonal-residential park).

Dead/compromised website: https://www.sebewaingriver.com/ returns 'Access Denied' to every visitor (browser and curl), its self-signed certificate expired 2026-08-22, and https://sebewaingriver.com/ returns '403: Access Forbidden ... Malware detected'. Same 'Access Denied' recorded in audit/price_research/private_2026-10-16. Google Maps still links it.
